results.name: Finset.min_le
results.source_text:
theorem min_le {a : α} {s : Finset α} (as : a ∈ s) : s.min ≤ a :=
  inf_le as

results.name: Finset.min_le_of_eq
results.source_text:
theorem min_le_of_eq {s : Finset α} {a b : α} (h₁ : b ∈ s) (h₂ : s.min = a) : a ≤ b :=
  WithTop.coe_le_coe.mp <| h₂.ge.trans (min_le h₁)

results.name: List.minimum
results.source_text:
/-- `minimum l` returns a `WithTop α`, the smallest element of `l` for nonempty lists, and `⊤` for
`[]` -/
def minimum (l : List α) : WithTop α :=
  argmin id l
results.docstring:
`minimum l` returns a `WithTop α`, the smallest element of `l` for nonempty lists, and `⊤` for

results.name: IsLowerSet.memberSubfamily
results.source_text:
theorem IsLowerSet.memberSubfamily (h : IsLowerSet (𝒜 : Set (Finset α))) :
    IsLowerSet (𝒜.memberSubfamily a : Set (Finset α)) := by
  rintro s t hts
  simp_rw [mem_coe, mem_memberSubfamily]
  exact And.imp (h <| insert_subset_insert _ hts) (mt <| @hts _)

results.name: IsLowerSet.nonMemberSubfamily
results.source_text:
theorem IsLowerSet.nonMemberSubfamily (h : IsLowerSet (𝒜 : Set (Finset α))) :
    IsLowerSet (𝒜.nonMemberSubfamily a : Set (Finset α)) := fun s t hts => by
  simp_rw [mem_coe, mem_nonMemberSubfamily]
  exact And.imp (h hts) (mt <| @hts _)

results.name: LinearPMap.IsLowerBound
results.source_text:
/-- `IsLowerBound T z c` is the property that `c * ‖x‖ ≤ ‖T x - z • x‖` for all `x : T.domain`. -/
def IsLowerBound (T : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H) (z : ℂ) (c : ℝ) : Prop := ∀ x : T.domain, c * ‖x‖ ≤ ‖T x - z • x‖
results.docstring: `IsLowerBound T z c` is the property that `c * ‖x‖ ≤ ‖T x - z • x‖` for all `x : T.domain`.

results.name: LinearPMap.isLowerBound_of_right_le
results.source_text:
lemma isLowerBound_of_right_le
    {T : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H} {z : ℂ} {c₁ c₂ : ℝ} (hle : c₁ ≤ c₂) (h : IsLowerBound T z c₂) :
    IsLowerBound T z c₁ :=
  fun x ↦ (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle (norm_nonneg x)).trans (h x)

results.name: LinearPMap.isLowerBound_of_left_le
results.source_text:
lemma isLowerBound_of_left_le
    {T₁ T₂ : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H} (hle : T₁ ≤ T₂) {z : ℂ} {c : ℝ} (h : IsLowerBound T₂ z c) :
    IsLowerBound T₁ z c :=
  fun x ↦ @hle.2 x ⟨x, hle.1 x.2⟩ rfl ▸ h ⟨x, hle.1 x.2⟩

results.name: LinearPMap.isLowerBound_closure
results.source_text:
lemma isLowerBound_closure
    {T : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H} {z : ℂ} {c : ℝ} (h : IsLowerBound T z c) : IsLowerBound T.closure z c := by
  by_cases hT : T.IsClosable
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨b, hb, hb'⟩ := mem_closure_iff_seq_limit.mp <|
      hT.graph_closure_eq_closure_graph ▸ T.closure.mem_graph x
    rw [nhds_prod_eq] at hb'
    refine le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto' (hb'.fst.norm.const_mul c)
      ((hb'.snd.sub <| hb'.fst.const_smul z).norm) fun n ↦ ?_
    obtain ⟨y, hy₁, hy₂⟩ := (mem_graph_iff _).mp (hb n)
    exact hy₁ ▸ hy₂ ▸ h y
  · rwa [closure_def' hT]

results.name: LinearPMap.isLowerBound_neg
results.source_text:
lemma isLowerBound_neg {T : H →ₗ.[ℂ] H} {z : ℂ} {c : ℝ} (h : IsLowerBound T z c) :
    IsLowerBound (-T) (-z) c :=
  fun x ↦ by simpa [neg_apply, norm_neg_add] using h x

results.name: IsLocalization.integerNormalization_eq_zero_iff
results.source_text:
theorem integerNormalization_eq_zero_iff [IsDomain R] (hM : M ≤ nonZeroDivisors R) (p : S[X]) :
    integerNormalization M p = 0 ↔ p = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨_, hb₁, hb₂⟩ := integerNormalization_spec M p
  letI := isDomain_of_le_nonZeroDivisors S hM
  letI := (faithfulSMul_iff_algebraMap_injective R S).mpr <| IsLocalization.injective S hM
  letI : Function.Injective <| mapRingHom (algebraMap R S) := by
    rw [coe_mapRingHom, map_injective_iff]
    exact IsLocalization.injective S hM
  rw [← _root_.map_eq_zero_iff (mapRingHom (algebraMap R S)) this, coe_mapRingHom, hb₂]
  exact smul_eq_zero_iff_right <| nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero (hM hb₁)

results.name: IsStrictlyPositive
results.source_text:
/-- An element of an ordered algebra is *strictly positive* if it is nonnegative and invertible.

NOTE: This definition will be generalized to the non-unital case in the future; do not unfold
the definition and use the API provided instead to avoid breakage when the refactor happens. -/
def IsStrictlyPositive {A : Type*} [LE A] [Monoid A] [Zero A] (a : A) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ a ∧ IsUnit a
results.docstring:

results.name: Physlib.PiTensorProduct.instAddCommMonoidElim_physlib
results.source_text:
/-- Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
  monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof. -/
instance : (i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → AddCommMonoid ((fun i => Sum.elim s1 s2 i) i) := fun i =>
  match i with
  | Sum.inl i => inst1 i
  | Sum.inr i => inst2 i
results.docstring:
Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof.
